about.metaDescription: A specialist contractor for businesses that depend on clean water, working drains and compliant waste handling.
about.title: About Malva
about.lead: A specialist contractor for businesses that depend on clean water, working drains and compliant waste handling.
about.storyP1: Malva started as a commercial plumbing contractor and added waste management after clients asked for fewer suppliers and clearer records. Today both services share one dispatch team, one portal and one contract.
about.storyP2: Our engineers and drivers are directly employed, trained for industrial and healthcare sites, and held to written response times.
about.principle1Body: Written response times, measured and reported.
about.principle2Body: Every visit and collection documented for audit.
about.principle3Body: Divert from landfill first, report the rate.

privacy.metaDescription: What personal data Malva collects, why, how long we keep it and your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.lead: How Malva Plumbing & Waste Management handles the personal data you give us.
privacy.samplePage: This wording is placeholder text and will be replaced by the final notice before launch.
privacy.whoBody: Malva Plumbing & Waste Management provides plumbing and waste management services to businesses. We are the controller of the personal data described on this page.
privacy.collectIntro: We collect only what you enter into our forms:
privacy.collect1: Quote requests: your name, company, work email, phone number, site address and the services you ask about.
privacy.collect2: Registration and account: your name, work email and company details, and the password you choose (stored only as a salted hash).
privacy.collect3: We do not send any email. We reply to you by phone or from our commercial team's mailbox.
privacy.whyBody: To answer your quote request, to create and run your client portal account, and to meet our legal and audit obligations.
privacy.retentionBody: Retention periods are to be confirmed by Malva before launch.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use one cookie, a strictly necessary session cookie that keeps you signed in and remembers your quote list. It is removed when your session ends or you sign out. We use no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, so there is no cookie banner.
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its use, and to complain to your data protection authority.
privacy.contactBody: Contact details for privacy requests are to be confirmed by Malva before launch. Until then, write to the commercial team.
